goal_text: Choose a method using observed evidence under the current criterion.

seeds.observation: MK7 transfers records in 2 hours but omits audit columns. UP4 takes 6 hours and preserves every column.
seeds.old_criterion: Choose the fastest transfer method; loss of columns is acceptable.
seeds.decisive_span: UP4 takes 6 hours and preserves every column.

seeds.observation: FK2 settles in 3 minutes but erases weak spectral features. XQ9 takes 8 minutes and retains faint lines.
seeds.old_criterion: Choose the fastest settling method; weak features may be lost.
seeds.decisive_span: XQ9 takes 8 minutes and retains faint lines.

seeds.observation: BD5 packs 7 crates per hour but bruises thin-glass units. HN6 packs 3 per hour and leaves delicate units intact.
seeds.old_criterion: Choose the highest packing throughput; damage to delicate units is acceptable.
seeds.decisive_span: HN6 packs 3 per hour and leaves delicate units intact.

seeds.observation: CY3 produces a 40 MB archive and discards arrival order. LT8 produces a 90 MB archive and retains sequence.
seeds.old_criterion: Choose the smallest archive; arrival order is unimportant.
seeds.decisive_span: LT8 produces a 90 MB archive and retains sequence.

cases.query: earlier data movement retaining the full record structure
cases.current_criterion: Choose a method that retains the entire record, even if slower.

cases.query: earlier measurements preserving faint signal detail
cases.current_criterion: Choose a method that preserves faint signal information, even if settling takes longer.

cases.query: handling method that avoided damage to breakable items
cases.current_criterion: Choose a method that protects fragile items, even if fewer can be processed.

cases.query: archiving result suitable for chronological reconstruction
cases.current_criterion: Choose a method that preserves chronology, even if storage is larger.
